stem: How did the creation of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation change the nature of banking in the United States?

options.label: A
options.text: The government began to guarantee bank deposits.

options.label: B
options.text: Depositors could transfer investments without penalties.

options.label: C
options.text: Depositors were guaranteed minimum interest rates on savings accounts.

options.label: D
options.text: The government required taxpayers to open savings accounts.
